name: revivify
lore:
### On the Rite of Restoration: Revivify

To witness **Revivify** is to see a flash of celestial amber, as if a stray sunbeam has momentarily pierced the veil of the Shadowfell. As the diamond catalyst—valued for its purity—dissolves into a glittering mist, the magic acts as a spiritual suture, stitching the soul back to its cooling vessel before the silver cord can fully sever.

Shaping the Weave for this rite feels like catching a falling star with bare hands. It is a frantic, searing tension; the caster must grasp the unraveling threads of a companion’s life and knot them tight against the inexorable pull of the Great Beyond. It is heavy, urgent work that demands absolute resolve.

**The Legend of the First Mourner**
Clerics attribute this miracle to Valerius of the Pale Dawn. Legend claims Valerius intercepted a reaper upon the banks of the Styx, offering a handful of crushed gems to stall the ferryman for a single heartbeat. He proved that within the first minute of passing, the gates of the afterlife are merely ajar—not yet locked—allowing a determined soul to be pulled back to the light.
